prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her left in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 40s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese poised refined beauty fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and natural skin tone, early 40s, long straight silver hair with a side part, vivid ice-blue coloured contact lenses with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, a faraway, unfocused gaze drifting just past the camera, lips softly parted, a dreamy, ethereal expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): extremely exaggerated 'Russian lips': huge, tall, doll-like lips with a dramatic amount of vertical height in both the upper and lower lip, a high, flared, strongly lifted upper lip with a very sharp, high and pronounced cupid's bow, very crisp, razor-clean, sharply drawn edges all around the mouth, a full, tall, plump lower lip, and a clearly visible forward projection of the whole pout in this three-quarter view; glossy nude-rose, perfectly balanced and elegant, never duck-like, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a high, straight, refined, surgically sculpted nose: a tall, slim, straight bridge, a narrow, pointed, projecting tip and clearly narrow nostril wings with slim, neat nostrils; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about eighty-three in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; two small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two straight bars across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; five small bar or rings through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit fourteen pieces above the lobe: seven classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, four studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and three in the conch and tragus; ten small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; five small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; eight small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear oxidized dark copper a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, dull blue-grey lead a miniature anvil on a shortest chain, blackened cast iron a round bell on a short chain, dull dark brass a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a hammer head on a long chain, tarnished dark silver a teardrop-shaped sinker on a long chain, dark patinated bronze a ship's anchor on a longer chain, dull pewter-grey tin a barrel-shaped weight on a longest chain; on the right ear dull dark brass a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, blackened cast iron a hammer head on a short chain, dull blue-grey lead a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, dark patinated bronze a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a long chain, dull pewter-grey tin a round bell on a long chain, oxidized dark copper a teardrop-shaped sinker on a longer chain, tarnished dark silver a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a dim lounge with deep teal velvet walls and a few soft blurred lamps in muted blue-green, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
